{{Top|leg}}
'''Military Hangar 15''' was located in [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and was used as a base for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[StealthX wing]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] starfighter wing had support of local ground crews.<ref name="Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>

With this as their base, the StealthX wing took part in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]], launching an all-out strike against the attacking [[Fifth Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Fifth Fleet]], while [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] Skywalker flew in a [[Jedi shadow bomb|shadow bomb]] attack on the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']].<ref name="Inferno" />
